newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU seeks gene maize data from Vienna, Luxembourg.
newsitem.headline: EU seeks gene maize data from Vienna, Luxembourg.

text.p: Bans by Austria and Luxembourg on the import and sale of genetically modified maize must be supported by new scientific evidence if they are to be allowed, a European Commission spokesman said on Tuesday.
"It's up to those countries to state what information they have," spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas told a news conference.
"This has to be fresh scientific information which justifies this withdrawal of approval. We are expecting Luxembourg to notify us...and the same applies to Austria," he added.
"It is quite clear that the Commission is fully aware of how sensitive these issues are so we would like to work out a solution which is acceptable to everybody," van der Pas said.

Luxemburg's health ministry announced its ban last Friday, questioning the haste with which the Commission had agreed last December to allow imports into the EU of Swiss chemical company Ciba Geigy's genetically modified maize.
Austria has also introduced a ban. --Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800 (PIC)
